title: OF THE CREEDE, OR, SYMBOLE OF THE APOSTLES.

segments.text: AFter we haue intreated of FAITH, it directly followeth now that we ſpeake of the ſum of thoſe things which are to bee beleeued, which we cal the Symbole of the Apostles, or the Apoſtolick Symbole.

The eſpecial Queſtions here are,
1 What a Symbole is.
2 What are the parts of the Apostolique Symbole.
